findings.issue: Raw generation accepts a filename that shared ledger readers cannot discover.
findings.disposition: Fixed: raw generation requires canonical ledger filename; intentional computed export remains separate.

findings.issue: A final read could reopen a different physical ledger after resolving its home.
findings.disposition: Fixed: retain an independent directory reference through final admission; a correlated replacement test verifies binding.

findings.issue: New private journal ancestors are not synchronized before public publication writes.
findings.disposition: Fixed: synchronize new private directory ancestry before pending/public writes; real ordering traces and injected failures verified.

findings.issue: Incomplete discovery may conceal another matching ledger during implicit selection or first publication.
findings.disposition: Fixed: incomplete enumeration cannot establish implicit uniqueness or first-publication absence; partial listing and explicit-home access remain usable.

findings.issue: Existing movement tests do not detect transaction replacements writing into an unrelated former home.
findings.disposition: Fixed: full transaction movement/commit/reopened-recovery oracle kills former-path rename mutation.

findings.issue: A database-error test accepts an unrelated ticket-ID diagnostic as success.
findings.disposition: Fixed: source/type negative cases require their intended actionable diagnostics; unrelated identity diagnostic mutant is rejected.

findings.issue: Backfill and migration bypass shared selection safeguards for incomplete scans and explicit unenumerated homes.
findings.disposition: Fixed: maintenance consumers share selection guards and propagate explicit home into nested migration; complete valid absence remains a no-op.
